fields.description: Relative weight of the service amount collected through this mode. Weights are normalised, so rows need not add up to 100.
fields.label: Percent

fields.description: Charged on the amount collected through this mode, e.g. 1.65 for card payments (the statement note "1.650% deduction, if patient pays by card"). The charge is taken off the collection and the doctor's commission is then computed on the net paid amount. Leave 0 for no deduction.
fields.label: Deduction %
